# Firestore Schema Contract

**Branch**: `001-training-tracker-app` | **Date**: 2026-03-20

This document is the authoritative contract for Firestore document shapes.
Any change to a document structure requires a corresponding update here and
a review of the security rules.

---

## Collection Hierarchy

```
/users/{uid}/
  exercises/{exerciseId}          — Exercise document
    sessions/{dateStr}            — Session document (dateStr = YYYY-MM-DD)
```

---

## Exercise Document

**Path**: `/users/{uid}/exercises/{exerciseId}`
**Document ID**: Auto-generated by Firestore

```json
{
  "name":      "Bench Press",
  "position":  1,
  "hidden":    false,
  "createdAt": "<Firestore Timestamp>"
}
```

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|-------|------|----------|-------|
| name | string | Yes | Case-preserved; uniqueness enforced case-insensitively at write time |
| position | number | Yes | Integer ≥ 1; re-indexed on every reorder/insert |
| hidden | boolean | Yes | `false` on create; `true` after hide action; never deleted |
| createdAt | Timestamp | Yes | Set once on creation; never updated |

**Standard list query** (exercises screen):
```
collection(`/users/${uid}/exercises`)
  .where('hidden', '==', false)
  .orderBy('position', 'asc')
```

---

## Session Document

**Path**: `/users/{uid}/exercises/{exerciseId}/sessions/{dateStr}`
**Document ID**: Date string `YYYY-MM-DD` (e.g., `2026-03-20`)

```json
{
  "date":      "2026-03-20",
  "sets":      [
    { "weight": 80,   "reps": 8 },
    { "weight": 82.5, "reps": 6 },
    { "weight": 85,   "reps": 5 }
  ],
  "updatedAt": "<Firestore Timestamp>"
}
```

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|-------|------|----------|-------|
| date | string | Yes | `YYYY-MM-DD`; matches document ID |
| sets | array | Yes | Ordered; each element is a Set object (see below); may be empty `[]` |
| updatedAt | Timestamp | Yes | Updated on every auto-save write |

**Today's session lookup**:
```
doc(`/users/${uid}/exercises/${exerciseId}/sessions/${todayStr}`)
```

**Last session lookup**:
```
collection(`/users/${uid}/exercises/${exerciseId}/sessions`)
  .orderBy('date', 'desc')
  .limit(2)
```
(If first result is today, use second result as "last"; else use first result.)

---

## Set Object (embedded in Session.sets)

```json
{ "weight": 80, "reps": 8 }
```

| Field | Type | Constraints |
|-------|------|-------------|
| weight | number | ≥ 0.5; decimal precision as entered (e.g., 82.5) |
| reps | number | Integer; ≥ 1 |

Sets are stored in position order (index 0 = set 1). Empty rows are never persisted.

---

## Security Rules

```javascript
rules_version = '2';
service cloud.firestore {
  match /databases/{database}/documents {
    match /users/{uid}/{document=**} {
      allow read, write: if request.auth != null
                         && request.auth.uid == uid;
    }
  }
}
```

This single rule covers all nested collections (`exercises` and `sessions`).
